description: Actions (Team C tool names) and facts that rules may reference. The extractor rejects candidates that use anything else. Agree changes with Team C.

actions.get_order_status: read an order's status and tracking
actions.create_return: open a return request for a delivered item
actions.update_delivery_address: change the delivery address of an order
actions.apply_voucher: issue a compensation voucher to the customer
actions.subscribe_bundle: telecom: subscribe a line to a bundle
actions.refund_bundle: telecom: refund a bundle bought by mistake
actions.refund_charge: telecom: refund a wrong or duplicated charge
actions.refund_vas: telecom: refund a content service added without consent
actions.open_bill_dispute: telecom: open a dispute on a postpaid bill
actions.grant_outage_compensation: telecom: compensate a customer for a network outage
actions.transfer_balance: telecom: transfer prepaid balance to another line
actions.activate_roaming: telecom: turn roaming on for a line
actions.get_puk: telecom: give the customer their SIM PUK code

order_section.note: noon_eg: which storefront section the order came from

return_eligible_tag.note: the offer carries the hassle-free returns / Returnable tag

warranty_tag.note: warranty-tagged items go to the seller or manufacturer service center

payment_method.note: values are each tenant's own; not normalized across tenants

identity_verified.note: telecom: line number (or landline) plus last 4 digits of the national ID

unpaid_invoices.note: 1 if the latest past-due invoice is not fully paid, else 0

paid_invoices.note: invoices with status paid or paid_late

prepaid_balance_minus_price.note: prepaid balance minus the bundle price

charge_confirmed_wrong.note: transactions.is_duplicate = 1 or a confirmed system error

refund_days.note: days of content-service charges being refunded
